import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if w <= 3:
        print("YES")
        return

    # build powers of w up to 2e9
    bases = []
    val = 1
    while val <= 2e9:
        bases.append(val)
        val *= w
    nDigits = len(bases)

    values = [-1] * nDigits
    curTotal = -sum(bases)

    works = False
    outer = True
    while outer:
        index = 0
        while True:
            values[index] += 1
            curTotal += bases[index]

            if values[index] != 2:
                if abs(curTotal) == m:
                    works = True
                break
            else:
                values[index] = -1
                curTotal -= bases[index] * 3
                index += 1
                if index == nDigits:
                    outer = False
                    break
    print("YES" if works else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
